author: blu
body: ProseTransition, ProseTemplate, ProseBlock and AnnotationNode are declared beside IRTextMeta in IR chapter IRChapter, which is the record that carries them to emission. They were here, and a plug could not read the pblocks and anns forms off the wire because the plug bundle takes IRChapter's declarations and deliberately leaves this chapter's 66 CST declarations behind.

author: blu
body: A citation names a work; a quotation reproduces one. A citation resolves through its quire to whatever file is on disk under that name. A quotation resolves through its digest to exactly one text -- the text that hashes to it, or nothing at all. That is the whole difference, and it is why quoting can be trusted and citing cannot.

author: blu
body: The trusted-key declaration is where a chapter says WHOSE signatures it will accept, and it lives in the source on purpose. The source is the one input the compiler is asked to compile and therefore trusts; the offered works arrive over a transport it does not. A manifest read from the works would let the messenger vouch for the message. Reading it from the source is the whole of the gate's protection.

author: blu
body: The floor is stamped onto every quotation only once the whole header has been read, because a chapter may declare its trust after the quotations that trust governs -- a reader should not have to say how much they trust before saying what they are trusting.

author: blu
body: Quotations are kept out of citations deliberately. Every phase after the parser -- the desugarer, the chapter scoper, the name resolver, the type checker -- walks citations, and a quotation is not a thing any of them should try to resolve to a file. Giving quotations their own field means none of those phases has to learn an exception.

author: blu
body: Sharing is sound for exactly the reason it is sound for tokens and spans: a text below `b` lives in the LEX deck or lower, and `phase-compact` rewinds to a deck position at or above `b`, so it survives. Above `b` is scratch and must still be copied by bytes.

author: blu
body: On saturation the ORIGINAL document is returned shared and sat is 1 -- the caller must raise CDX9002 for the phase, which halts the compile before the shared scratch is compacted out from under it, exactly the CHECK-KEEP mc-sat contract.
